sqlite.name: crawl_runs
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE crawl_runs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	searches INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	seen INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	added INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	price_changed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	removed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	errors JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

sqlite.name: listings
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE listings (
	id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	rooms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_new BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	price INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	okrug VARCHAR(20), 
	status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	data JSON NOT NULL, 
	first_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	removed_at DATETIME, 
	page_checked_at DATETIME, 
	page_alive BOOLEAN, 
	page_note VARCHAR(160), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

indexes.name: ix_listings_search
indexes.create: CREATE INDEX ix_listings_search ON listings (city, rooms, is_new, status, price)

sqlite.name: security_events
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE security_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chat_id VARCHAR(32), 
	visitor_id VARCHAR(36), 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	"where" VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	sample TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

sqlite.name: tracked_searches
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE tracked_searches (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	rooms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_new BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	okrug VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	budget_max INTEGER, 
	requested_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_requested_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_crawled_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (city, rooms, is_new, okrug)
)

sqlite.name: users
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_login_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

indexes.name: ix_users_email
indexes.create: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

sqlite.name: auth_sessions
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

sqlite.name: listing_features
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE listing_features (
	listing_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	value JSON, 
	source VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (listing_id, "key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(listing_id) REFERENCES listings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

sqlite.name: listing_prices
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE listing_prices (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	listing_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	price INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(listing_id) REFERENCES listings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

sqlite.name: visitors
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE visitors (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

sqlite.name: chats
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE chats (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	visitor_id VARCHAR(36), 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	profile JSON, 
	memory JSON, 
	state JSON, 
	state_version INTEGER, 
	last_seq INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(visitor_id) REFERENCES visitors (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

sqlite.name: chat_commands
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE chat_commands (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chat_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	progress JSON NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (chat_id, command_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(chat_id) REFERENCES chats (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

sqlite.name: chat_events
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE chat_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chat_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	seq INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (chat_id, seq), 
	FOREIGN KEY(chat_id) REFERENCES chats (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
